subject: Commit tiers, ramp schedule and payment cadence for Nimbus deal
messages:
From: Emily Dawson <emily.dawson@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring long-term commit pricing and ramping

Hi Sergio,

We'd like to explore committed spend options for the next 2–3 years. Key asks: term discounts, flexible ramp (we expect usage to grow substantially Y1→Y3), billing cadence (annual vs monthly), and any true-up/overage mechanics.

Can you share an example structure and ballpark economics for a 2-year vs 3-year commitment? We're targeting a decision by end of August.

Thanks,
Emily Dawson
Director, Platform Engineering
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: none

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Dawson <emily.dawson@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring long-term commit pricing and ramping

Hi Emily — great to hear from you. Short answer: yes, we can do tiered term discounts with ramp schedules and flexible true-ups. I'll put together a concise proposal with two options (2yr and 3yr) and a suggested ramp schedule.

To make the numbers useful, could you share: 1) current monthly token spend last 3 months; 2) expected % growth per quarter; 3) any procurement constraints (PO timing, invoice cadence)?

I've attached an outline spreadsheet (initial_pricing_framework.xlsx) with the inputs we'll use — feel free to drop numbers in. If you prefer, let's do a 30-minute call tomorrow to align.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_pricing_framework.xlsx (stub)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Dawson <emily.dawson@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing proposal: 2yr / 3yr commit options (draft)

Emily — thanks for the data you dropped into the sheet. Per our conversation, please find a clear comparison below (draft):

Option A — 24 month commit
- Year 1 commit: 50% of baseline annualized usage; Year 2 true-up to 110% of baseline (example ramp).
- Discount: 18% off list on committed tokens if paid annually upfront; 15% if billed monthly.
- True-up: annual reconciliation with overage charged at 75% of list price.

Option B — 36 month commit
- Year 1 commit: 40% of baseline; Year 2: 70%; Year 3: 100% (phased ramp).
- Discount: 26% off list on committed tokens if paid annually upfront; 22% if billed monthly.
- True-up: annual reconciliation with overage charged at 65% of list price.

Additional notes:
- We can add a ramp-protection clause: if actual usage is < 70% of committed in a given year, we offer a one-time credit up to 10% of that year's committed spend (subject to finance approval).
- SLA credit terms intact for both options.
- Legal will need to review payment terms (we can accommodate annual upfront in most cases).

I've attached a numeric commitment table (nimbus_commit_table.xlsx) and a short term-sheet PDF for review. If this looks directionally right I will request internal approval for the requested discount floors.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbus_commit_table.xlsx, redwood_term_sheet.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing proposal: 2yr / 3yr commit options (request for approval)

Team — forwarding the draft terms from Nimbus. Summary of ask: they're interested in a 3-year structure but will consider 2-year. They want competitive delta to justify 3yr. My recommended offer (to get signature this month):
- 24mo: 20% discount (annual prepmt) / 16% (monthly invoice)
- 36mo: 28% discount (annual prepmt) / 24% (monthly invoice)
- Add ramp true-up mechanics and 1x ramp-protection credit as described in draft

Risks / asks:
- Finance: confirm we can accept annual upfront with standard credit terms and whether we require an advanced invoice for Y1.
- Legal: confirm we can include the ramp-protection credit language and overage pricing.
- Revenue: do we want to go to 30% on 3yr if customer pushes?

Please reply with approve / approve with edits / decline. I'm aiming to send a final term sheet to Nimbus by Friday EOD.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Sergio Alvarez
Subject: Pricing proposal: 2yr / 3yr commit options (draft)

(embedded spreadsheet omitted)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-16T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing proposal: 2yr / 3yr commit options (request for approval)

Sergio — approve with constraints.

- Approve 36mo discount up to 30% provided: (a) customer commits to minimum annual consumption schedule (we'll use the ramp table from the spreadsheet), and (b) they pay Year 1 annually upfront or provide an irrevocable PO with 30-day payment terms.
- Approve 24mo at up to 20% for annual upfront only.
- Ramp-protection credit OK but limit to a one-time credit applied in year-end reconciliation and capped at 10% of the committed year spend. Finance to confirm cap mechanics.
- Legal to review specific contract language; include standard audit and data residency clauses.

Karthik: please confirm the accounting treatment and whether we need a revenue deferral schedule. Marissa: if you can get verbal nod from procurement I think we can move quickly.

Laura Bennett
VP Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Dawson <emily.dawson@nimbus-analytics.com>, procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Final term sheet and signature request — Nimbus (RDW-2026-NIM-74)

Emily — thanks for the patience; we've locked internal approvals and have two final routes. Attached: RDW-NIM-commitment-v1.pdf (term sheet). Highlights: 

Option 1 — 24 month (annual upfront)
- Discount: 20% off list on committed tokens
- Ramp: Year1 50% baseline, Year2 true-up to 110%
- True-up: annual reconciliation; overage at 75% list

Option 2 — 36 month (annual upfront)
- Discount: 30% off list on committed tokens (following internal approval)
- Ramp: Year1 40%, Year2 70%, Year3 100%
- True-up: annual reconciliation; overage at 65% list; one-time ramp-protection credit (max 10% of committed year spend)

Payment: Year 1 annual upfront preferred; we can accept irrevocable PO with 30-day terms as an alternative (requires finance sign-off).

Next steps:
1) Let us know which option you prefer.
2) Sign term sheet via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&po=12345
3) We will issue an invoice/PO instructions on signature.

If you need any tweaks to the ramp table we can adjust before DocuSign. Please aim to sign by 2026-08-28 if you want to lock the stated pricing for September invoices.

Thanks — cc'ing procurement and our revenue ops for visibility.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDW-NIM-commitment-v1.pdf
